draftId.description: Gmail draftId of the existing draft for this thread, if the client already knows it. When present the backend updates that draft directly instead of scanning Gmail, which avoids the create-create race that flooded the user's drafts folder with duplicates.

paymentMethod.description: Payment method used for this checkout

checkoutUrl.description: Hosted Lemon Squeezy checkout URL when redirect is required

bankTransferIntent.description: Bank transfer instructions when paymentMethod is SEPAY_BANK_TRANSFER

digestSendDayOfWeek.description: ISO day-of-week the weekly digest is sent: Monday=1 .. Sunday=7.

displayName.description: Google profile display name. Read transiently from the OAuth session principal on each request — never persisted to the database (privacy).

avatarUrl.description: Google profile picture URL. Read transiently from the OAuth session principal on each request — never persisted to the database (privacy).

snippet.description: Short preview of the latest message in the thread, fetched live from Gmail (never persisted).

latestMessageId.description: Gmail message id of the latest message in the thread, used to open an in-place reader. Null when the live Gmail display fetch was unavailable.

draftId.description: Gmail draft id of the saved reply draft for this thread, used to preview the draft body in-place. Null when the thread has no draft.

currentPlanCode.description: Tenant's currently-active plan code. Falls back to FREE when no active paid plan period exists.

features.description: Enabled features for this plan, sorted by feature catalog sort order

dataSource.description: Source of this page. PROJECTION = DB-backed inbox projection; LIVE_GMAIL = live Gmail metadata fallback; SYNCING = backfill in flight, items is empty, render a syncing banner.

renderedText.description: Transient Gmail text/plain render fallback. Not persisted by Zero Mail.

renderedHtml.description: Transient sanitized Gmail HTML render. Not persisted by Zero Mail.

ApiError.description: RFC 9457 ProblemDetail extended with code/params/fieldErrors. Wire shape produced by Spring 7 ProblemDetail.setProperty(...) flattened by Jackson 3 ProblemDetailJacksonMixin. Phase 1.1 introduces this contract; the FE switches on `code`.

type.description: RFC 9457 problem type URI; defaults to `about:blank`.

title.description: Generic English diagnostic. NOT the user-facing message — FE ignores it.

status.description: HTTP status code echoed in the body.

detail.description: Generic English diagnostic. NOT the user-facing message — FE ignores it.

instance.description: Optional URI identifying this specific occurrence.

code.description: Stable dotted hierarchical key (e.g. `error.auth.unauthorized`). Frontend localizes via the errors.* dictionary. ALWAYS PRESENT.

additionalProperties.description: Allow-listed scalar value: string, integer, number, or boolean. Filtered through AllowedParamScalars before serialization.

params.description: Allow-listed ICU placeholder scalars for the FE error message. Filtered through AllowedParamScalars; never carries raw user content, Gmail body fragments, SQL constraint names, or exception class names.

fieldErrors.description: Per-field validation errors. Present only on validation failures.

message.description: Transitional alias of `code`, kept for one phase per CONTEXT.md decision D-C1. Prefer `code`.

FieldErrorDto.description: Per-field validation error. CONTEXT.md decision D-C2: { field, code, params }. The JHipster `message` and `objectName` fields are deliberately rejected — the frontend localizes the dotted `code` via the errors.field.* dictionary.

field.description: Dotted path to the offending field, e.g. `email`, `templates[0].key`.

code.description: Dotted hierarchical key inside the errors.field.* namespace.

additionalProperties.description: Allow-listed scalar value: string, integer, number, or boolean. Filtered through AllowedParamScalars before serialization.

params.description: Allow-listed scalars (numbers, booleans, dotted keys, short resource identifiers). Never raw user content.
